text:
Avery Johnson: demo tenant is *super* slow today. getting awkward pauses on streaming + the Console latency chart looks angry. anyone else seeing this? we’re 25 min out from a prospect call :sweat:

Markus Klein: seeing it too on my side (US). stream starts, but TTFB is like 3–6s instead of ~800ms. which scenario are you running?

Avery Johnson: “Streaming chat + tool calling” from the standard script. same canned prompts. using `demo-std-v1` tenant.

Markus Klein: ok. quick triage checklist:
1) confirm you’re on route `chat-demo-primary`
2) check if we’re getting throttled (429) vs just slow
3) verify region (us-east vs us-west)

Avery Johnson: no 429s. just slow. region showing us-east in the request panel.

Markus Klein: looping in platform. @Rafael Mendes @Priya Natarajan — demo tenant perf regression right now. TTFB 3–6s, token rate down. Prospect demo in ~20.

Rafael Mendes: on it. do we have a dashboard link?

Markus Klein: yep:
- Grafana (Demo Tenant Overview): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/demo-tenant-overview?tenant=demo-std-v1
- Console saved view (Latency/Cost): https://console.redwood.ai/demo-std-v1/observability/saved-views/latency-cost
- Error panel: https://console.redwood.ai/demo-std-v1/observability/errors?window=30m

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: checking. do we know if this is only us-east?

Avery Johnson: I can try us-west if there’s a safe toggle. but i don’t want to freestyle right before the call.

Markus Klein: please don’t change tenant config 20 min pre-demo :grimacing: we can use the “Plan B” mini-demo if needed.

RedwoodBot: Incident channel suggestion: If customer-facing demo is impacted, consider opening #eng-sre bridge and tagging “demo-tenant”.

Sean Gallagher: saw the ping. I’m here. If this is real latency regression, we should route around it rather than debug live. @Mina Haddad can we force fallback to secondary pool quickly?

Mina Haddad: depends what’s slow. if it’s GPU saturation in primary, routing to `chat-demo-secondary` should help. if it’s gateway/telemetry lag, won’t.

Rafael Mendes: looking at Grafana now. p95 latency up ~4x since ~15 mins ago. 5xx flat. GPU util is pinned on the demo primary pool.

Priya Natarajan: I’m in. looks like autoscaler didn’t add capacity (queue depth rising). could be a stuck scaler job or capacity cap hit. what’s current replica count?

Rafael Mendes: 2 replicas when it should be 4 for business hours. queue depth ~40–60. that explains the TTFB.

Chloe Martin: also seeing Console dashboards lagging a bit but the request traces show real queueing. not just UI.

Priya Natarajan: ok, we can do a safe action: temporarily route demo route to secondary pool (has headroom) and then fix autoscaler. Mina, can you confirm the policy we use for the demo tenant is allowed to flip live?

Mina Haddad: yes, we can swap the route target group for `chat-demo-primary` -> `demo-secondary` via the saved “failover” policy. it’s what we documented for live demos.

Markus Klein: +1 that’s the least risky. just need it to not break the talk track.

Avery Johnson: as long as output and clickpath stays the same i’m good. i can avoid mentioning the pool.

Rafael Mendes: doing the flip now. ETA 2–3 min for config propagate.

RedwoodBot: Config change detected: tenant=demo-std-v1 route=chat-demo-primary action=update_target_group requested_by=rmendes

Logan Wright: FYI telemetry: when queue depth spikes, cost dashboards can show weird per-request token/sec. not wrong, just jitter. if you’re showing Console, stay on the “Last 1h” view not “Last 5m”.

Markus Klein: good call. Avery, if you show the dashboard, use 1h window and call out “stable trends” not the moment-to-moment.

Avery Johnson: got it.

Rafael Mendes: flip complete. can someone retry the script?

Markus Klein: re-running curl now.

Markus Klein: TTFB back to ~900ms, token rate normal. :raised_hands:

Avery Johnson: testing in the sample app… looks normal again. streaming starts immediately.

Priya Natarajan: great. root cause: autoscaler stuck / capped. we’ll dig after the demo. Rafael, can you open a follow-up ticket and pin this thread?

Rafael Mendes: yep. also recommending we add an alert for “replicas < desired during business hours” specifically for demo tenant.

Sean Gallagher: +1. this is exactly the kind of thing we should page on during demo windows. also we should document the “failover policy” as the first step in the sales runbook.

Chloe Martin: I’ll update the saved views with a “Demo Live” preset (1h window, p95, queue depth). less clicking when people are stressed.

Markus Klein: thank you all. Avery, if it degrades again mid-call, pivot to the 2-min hosted API mini-demo and narrate Dedicated/Private with screenshots. don’t fight the tenant live.

Avery Johnson: :thumbsup: appreciate the save. heading into the call now.

Rafael Mendes: post-call please drop any notes if the prospect asked about perf/regions. we’ll incorporate into the standard objection handling.

Avery Johnson: will do.

Priya Natarajan: after-hours action items:
- investigate scaler job stuck + set higher min replicas during NA demo hours
- add alerting on demo pool saturation
- confirm secondary pool capacity is reserved

Sean Gallagher: ok closing the loop from SRE side. ping if it flaps again.
